summary: BUILD: `taskset -c 0-11 lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true GX/SingularII/Models.lean` exits 0 in 21 s wall with no output (no warning, no error, no sorry). All 13 'sorry' hits are in docstrings or comments. `taskset -c 0-11 lake build GX` (re-run by this audit): 'Build completed successfully (8738 jobs)', no Causal.* rebuild. AXIOMS (#print axioms on the fresh olean): isVirtuallyTame_of_descending, local_virt_tame_descending, not_localVirtTameStatement, ThinCex.local_virt_tame_counterexample, ThinCex.not_forall_hasLocalTamifyingCharts_VV, isVirtuallyTame_of_hasMaximalLifts, isVirtuallyTame_of_isXAManifold_of_hasFiniteLocalDegree, isVirtuallyTame_of_isXAManifold_of_isTame, local_virt_tame_liftable, local_virt_tame_of_charts, local_virt_tame_forward, not_forall_isVirtuallyTame_of_opens, cex_start_singular_manifold_homeomorphic, forall_isTame_iff_printed and spread_top_deck use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. DIFF: the backup campaign/WP-44b/Models.pre-WP-44b.lean.bak is byte-identical to git HEAD, and the diff against it touches docstrings only: header provenance line, the theo:local_virt_tame bullet (now **marked**), the 'Details' heading, the DEC-67(e)/DEC-109 sentences, the hypothesis-checklist row, a new DEC-109 ruling paragraph at the top of SCOPE (d), the last sentence of SCOPE (d), and two declaration docstrings (local_virt_tame_liftable, local_virt_tame_descending) that named the removed GX.local_virt_tame. No statement, proof or name changed, as the report says. FIDELITY under DEC-109: the certified form is the descending-chart form. isVirtuallyTame_of_descending carries every hypothesis of l.1974 (IsAnalyticModelFamily, IsLocallyGaloisian for each model, HasAutContinuousTamifying = a tamifying topology on X̃_α on which aeAutMapsMax acts continuously, X locally unloopable as the standing assumption l.1660) plus exactly the ruled condition (every singular point the centre of an X_A-chart with IsDescendingChartMap); it does NOT assume IsXAManifold, so it is stronger than the ruled form there, and M is universe-polymorphic. local_virt_tame_descending is the printed iff with (i) restricted to X_A-manifolds whose singular points centre descending charts, which is what DEC-109 rules. The added condition is satisfiable and not vacuous (IsLiftableChartMap.isDescendingChartMap with isLiftableChartMap_refl / isLiftableChartMap_modelChartSelf at the models' own singular points, isDescendingChartMap_of_homeomorph when r is an isomorphism), and it does not carry the conclusion: the proof builds the local topologies descTop from T_α and glues them (exists_isTamifyingTopology_of_local). The (i) => (ii) direction is obtained from htam rather than from (i); that is the paper's trivial direction and is honestly stated (local_virt_tame_forward). The refutation of the printed form (LocalVirtTameStatement, carrying the paper's hypotheses after the WP-43g round-1 fix) is unchanged. DOCSTRING CONTRACT: the first 4000 characters carry ** marks for the ten closed rows, theo:local_virt_tame included; cex:start_singular_manifold_homeomorphic and lem:spread_top (both partial in the REPORT) are unmarked. Marking theo:local_virt_tame is justified by DEC-109 under DEC-27 (a ruling accepts the corrected form, so the row is CLOSED), and the bullet keeps the refutation beside the mark. REPORT: lists all 12 labels the file certifies, statuses and marks agree with the header, theo:local_virt_tame moves partial -> closed with its decls, the hypothesis note says 'ACCEPTED by DEC-109', the questions are emptied and the ruling field cites DEC-109. Every declaration named in the new SCOPE (d) paragraph exists in the file (checked by grep). The paper's other labels in l.1889–2150 (ex:follows_proposition_brunswic_cauchy, rem:intuitively_spread_thinner_than, rem:hypothesis_model_spaces_necessary) are covered in GX/BTZ/VirtTame.lean and GX/SingularII/SpreadTop.lean, not in this file. NAMES: no declaration added or removed; the descending-form names occur only in this file across GX/ and scaffold/. Two minor points only.
